endpoints.title: Defence notices
endpoints.summary: The defence and dual-use procurement notices, newest first, 50 a page (up to 200). Each carries its buyer, country, dates, stated value, CPV codes, the four defence signals, why it is in scope, its version number, a link to the source and the source's credit line.

params.name: deadline_after
params.text: deadline on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: deadline_before
params.text: deadline on or before this date

params.name: value_min
params.text: stated value at least this amount (in the notice's own currency)

params.name: status
params.text: the state as of now, for example open (default), forthcoming, expired or awarded

params.name: scope
params.text: core (default): the notice itself is defence; supply: only the buyer is a defence body; all

params.name: collapse
params.text: show a national notice once when its TED notice is in the same answer (default true)

params.name: source
params.text: source codes, comma-separated; a key reads only the licensed ones

endpoints.title: One notice
endpoints.summary: One notice by its id, in the same shape as the list, with the same notice as other licensed sources published it.

endpoints.title: The archive of a notice
endpoints.summary: Every version of the notice we observed since we first saw it: when it was observed, which fields changed (deadline, value, status, codes and more) and the fields of that version. Versions we added when we corrected how a field is read are marked, not hidden.
